name: Project Vector-Key Prompt & Agent Directive Library

prompts.title: Autonomous 256GB USB Vector-Key Provisioning
prompts.prompt: Execute complete prestaging and provisioning of the attached 256GB PNY USB 3.2 drive into an autonomous, offline-capable, Ventoy-based Fleet Rescue and Automated Deployment Drive. Wipe partitions, build Ventoy GPT layout, generate Anaconda Kickstart and Windows autounattend XML, configure custom verbose GRUB2 submenus with loglevel=7, and stage offline Qwen2.5-7B RAG engine.

prompts.title: NVIDIA RTX 4080 Secondary Passthrough Staging
prompts.prompt: Unbind secondary NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU (0000:01:00.0) from host nvidia driver and dynamically register with vfio-pci. Launch Bazzite Gaming VM with vendor-id hidden and host-passthrough CPU mode.

prompts.title: Airgapped HID Keystroke & YubiKey OTP Injector
prompts.prompt: Read input script and transmit scancodes over /dev/hidg0 USB Gadget interface to simulate physical USB keyboard typing at 120 WPM into an airgapped system.
